# Companion Scan Quest

> Companion Scan Quest maps a room with Meta Quest 3 and WebXR. It places labelled pins on the surfaces and objects it finds, then exports a 3D glTF scan (.glb) with a Markdown report. The scan can be opened and edited in a desktop viewer.

Companion Scan Quest is part of the Companion Intelligence platform (https://ci.computer/). Scanning works without signing in. Signing in with a Companion Intelligence account lets the app find your memory servers and their language models. Pins and room geometry are kept in the browser between sessions. Remote vision is optional: you point the app at a CV server. Support: support@ci.computer

## Pages

- [Scan app](https://meta.ci.computer/): a status overlay on desktop, and the WebXR session on Meta Quest 3
- [Desktop viewer](https://meta.ci.computer/viewer): open and edit an exported scan in a browser
